title: Universal adult franchise in India
description: The Constitution guarantees voting rights to all adult citizens, making elections central to democracy.

title: First general elections
description: Large-scale elections conducted with rules, constituencies, and election symbols to help voters participate.

title: Change of government through elections
description: A key example showing that elections can remove rulers and bring new parties to power.

title: Coalition era strengthens
description: Multi-party competition increases; alliances and coalition governments become common in many periods.

title: Congress government in Haryana
description: The Congress party began its term leading the government in Haryana, which lasted until the next state election.

title: Nyaya Yudh movement and Lok Dal victory
description: Chaudhary Devi Lal led the ‘Nyaya Yudh’ (Struggle for Justice) movement and formed the Lok Dal party. In the subsequent State Assembly elections, his party and its allies won a clear majority (76 out of 90 seats), and he became the Chief Minister.

title: Return of Congress in Haryana
description: After the Lok Dal’s four-year rule ended, new elections were held in Haryana. The Lok Dal failed to gain popular support, and the Congress party formed the government.

title: Rise in popular participation
description: National Election Studies data shows a sharp increase in popular participation in India, with election-related activity rising from 8% in 1996 to 32% in 2004.

title: Technology and election management
description: Wider use of Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) and stronger election administration increase speed and reduce certain malpractices.

title: Cost of Lok Sabha elections
description: The Indian government spent about ₹3,500 crores to conduct the Lok Sabha elections, amounting to roughly ₹40 per person on the voters’ list.

title: Gulbarga Lok Sabha election result
description: In the Gulbarga Lok Sabha constituency, Mallikarjun Kharge of the Indian National Congress was declared elected after securing 50.82% of the total votes polled.

title: Reserved seats in Lok Sabha
description: Reservation of seats in the Lok Sabha stood at 84 seats for Scheduled Castes and 47 seats for Scheduled Tribes, based on their proportion in the total population.

title: Women’s Reservation Act passed
description: The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (Women’s Reservation Act 2023) was passed, mandating one-third reservation of seats for women in Parliament and Legislative Assemblies.

title: Elections as representation and accountability
description:
Elections perform key democratic functions: choosing leaders, making governments accountable, giving citizens a chance to evaluate performance, and ensuring political competition.
	Debates include money power, media influence, and fairness.
